summary: Lane audio passes round 1. The one major item, audio-r1-confirm, holds on re-measurement. `audio/build.py --gates` passes, and its output matches the engineer's log line for line except the instant gate, which now counts 42 instant cues instead of 37 because of the 5 new world cues. In the kit numbers: worst laptop loss is 2.47 LU (f_hesmi_attack_swing). The physical contact floor is 0.088 (f_ulkro_hit) and the soft top is 0.240, under 0.30. The nearest dash pair is 8.66 dB (1/3-octave) and 8.46 dB (confusability), so none is under 8 dB. probe_audio_kits passes, probe_audio_listener passes on seeds 3, 5 and 7, and probe_audio_soften passes with the engineer's exact numbers. probe_audio_announcer, pieces, ambience, procs, cc and team_private all pass. The minor items audio-1b-4, audio-1b-5, audio-r2-01, audio-r2-03 and audio-r2-04 pass. audio-r2-02 is partly done, as the engineer reported. The Dawn Seal set and shatter sound in real RIFT matches. The Ringshade muffled hit is wired in the engine but stays silent in real matches: the sim does not emit `shaded` yet (src/contracts/sim.ts has no such field), and that part is the open systems handoff. For Vashil's chord, the bots never chorded in a match. To close that gap I ran a scratch sim arena (real vashil.json, the same setup as probe_sim_kit_hooks). It shows the sim emits an area event {ability vashil_hum, vfx vashil_passive_hum, no sfx} only on the chord: 2 stuns, both targets hushed, and none on 3 lone chimes. probe_audio_world's stub then maps that exact shape to c_vashil_chord at the area. I measured the new cues' loudness myself with ffmpeg ebur128. Each matches its recipe (mono +3 dB): seal_set -26, seal_break -20, chord -19, noon_bell -24, gorge_gust -26, hit_shaded -22. All are under the announcer's -18, all have true peak <= -3.6 dBTP, and none is on the voice bus. Spectra match the descriptions: chord peaks 217/325 Hz (A3/E4), bell partials 293/588/880 Hz, and the gust's centroid rises 503 -> 740 -> 1184 Hz. typecheck exit 0 and content:check OK (0 warnings). I found no regressions. Minor notes, not failures: (1) a shaded ability hit on a structure plays the thud but its kit 'hit' stays at full gain, because only the auto path applies SHADED_GAIN. (2) The comment at index.ts:1351 says the Ringshade counts the structure's own Wicks, but the sim counts the striker's (structures.ts:166-189). (3) The magic fighters' kit hits still have almost no >2 kHz contact: dunsom, vashil and sukri attack_hit 0.000-0.011; dunsom and vashil hit 0.002-0.006. The gate and the fix hint cover physical fighters only, so this is not a failure.
